surfaces.description: rustfmt check over the engine crate (pinned toolchain)
Clippy with -D warnings over all targets, CPU default features

Full default-feature host suite: lib target plus every integration target, CPU only. Fixture-gated tests skip on hosts without the named locations; the skips are recorded as evidence, and the floor counts only executed tests (passed plus failed minus fixture-skip lines; ignored and filtered-out excluded) so a collection regression cannot pass silently.
surfaces.baseline_note: Waiver retired 2026-11-04: the historical allowed failure (published_text::published_files_carry_no_internal_plan_labels, pre-existing at ec0296ed9 from internal plan labels in docs/plans/q36-multigpu-pcie-ring.md, engine/src/capability/bundle.rs, engine/src/family/qwen36/cuda/card_block_device_tests.rs) is reconciled by the shared sanitizer policy — the test passes and any regression now fails outright. The floor counts only executed tests (passed plus failed minus fixture-skip lines): verified 2988 executed on a fixture-equipped host and 2975 on a fixture-less host at ec0296ed9; 2950 sits just below the fixture-less count. Under --nocapture, libtest writes the 'test NAME ... ' prefix without a newline, so prints from the test body can land on that line (glued status) or push the status onto a later bare line; the parser completes those torn shapes while keeping the counted==summary invariant (any miscount still fails). The >60-second libtest notices are noise lines and do not affect the count. Fail-fast removed 2026-11-05: cargo's default aborts the remaining test executables once one binary fails, silently shrinking coverage (the slice-3 receipt bound 386c469c3 ran 60 of 72 targets for exactly this reason); --no-fail-fast plus the collector's facts-reconciled target-coverage check now refuse any verdict whose observed Running lines miss a declared target.

surfaces.description: The pure selection and execution-path logic of the single-row EXL3 kernel, run by name on the host: the served kernel is wide1, an explicit FIFI_EXL3_SINGLE_GATHER wins over the registered default, records name the kernel, a harness on the shuffle kernel is refused, and the launch-count guard rejects a run whose routed calls fell back to the shuffle kernel or never launched the intended one. A device receipt (D1 tests, cost harness) needs this selection AND the launch counts it checks; this surface is the host half, and the device negative control (d1_negative_control_the_shuffle_kernel_is_rejected) is the device half. min_ran pins the tests so that a deleted or renamed test cannot pass silently.

Seed device surface: the cuda_smoke target (4 tests) under the native-cuda feature. INFERENCE_CUDA_REQUIRE_DEVICE=1 makes a missing device a failure instead of a silent skip, so a green run is device evidence. Requires an authorized GPU lease (fifi-gpu-run) plus the CUDA build container; never selected by default.
surfaces.baseline_note: PENDING: no device evidence collected yet; this branch is CPU-only and device collection waits for an authorized lease. The fast/extended device-gate surfaces (per-lane compositions under features like cuda-q8-reference, cuda-fault-qualification, cuda-arms-qualification) will be declared from the owning lanes' verified argv, not invented here.
